about.title: About Rick J Berube
about.bioExtended: I became interested in landscape oil painting in the early 1990s, heavily inspired by the great television artist Bob Ross. Watching him every Saturday morning inspired me to paint using the wet-on-wet technique, which remained my primary style for many years. In 2017, I expanded into acrylics, colored pencils, and charcoal, which opened exciting new doors for custom commissions, portraits, wildlife, 3D art, and fan art.
about.storyParagraph2: Over the past decades, I have painted more than 500 original works—capturing the dramatic coastal cliffs of Maine, peaceful New England forests, majestic wildlife, delicate florals, and intimate portraits of loved ones and pets.
about.awardsSubtitle: Honors bestowed by the City of Methuen Mayor's Office
about.awardsFooter: Display Location: Methuen City Hall Rotunda
about.studioDescription: In 2019, I designed and custom-built my own dedicated 33' x 17' painting and video recording studio in Methuen. Equipped with natural lighting, multiple DSLR overhead video angles, and specialized wet-on-wet easels, this studio is where every painting comes to life and where each YouTube demonstration video is produced.
